### Short answer
The passages support only a partial chain: high-speed digital / SerDes semiconductor validation involves Interface Test and Power Distribution Network test contexts using scopes, and SI flow lists measurable items such as IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR impedance, but the passages do not state any required oscilloscope model, bandwidth, sample rate, option, standard version, or pass/fail condition [1][2][3][32].
| Chain layer | Supported mapping | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Semiconductor market / application requirement | High-speed digital / SerDes validation context: the source describes “Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces” and connects SerDes, SI / PI, PCB / PCBA, and validation instruments [3][33]. | [3][33] |
| Measurable parameter | The SI flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR Impedance as measurement / analysis items [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Oscilloscope role | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices; Power Distribution Network is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Required Oscilloscope capability | Not specified: the passages explicitly say the source does not provide model, bandwidth, data rate, standard version, software option, test condition, or pass/fail criteria [1][2][32]. | [1][2][32] |

- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

- Connector type：25-pin D-Sub，female。
- RFFE port 1 / 2 的 VIO、DATA、CLK 電壓範圍為 0 V to +2 V，1 mV step，maximum current 20 mA。
- CLK configurable clock rate：31.25 kHz to 26 MHz。
- GPIO 1 to GPIO 8：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 20 mA。
- GPIO 9 and 10：voltage range –5 V to +10 V；typ. –6 V to +12 V；voltage step size 5 mV；maximum current 100 mA。
- Model .03 提供 voltage and current measurement with switchable source resistance；32 internal ADC channels 可同時量測每個 RFFE 與 GPIO pin 的 voltage and current。

### Short answer
The passages support only a partial chain: high-speed digital / SerDes semiconductor validation involves Interface Test and Power Distribution Network test contexts using scopes, and SI flow lists measurable items such as IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR impedance, but the passages do not state any required oscilloscope model, bandwidth, sample rate, option, standard version, or pass/fail condition [1][2][3][32].
| Chain layer | Supported mapping | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Semiconductor market / application requirement | High-speed digital / SerDes validation context: the source describes “Transmission Channel and validation challenges electrical Interfaces” and connects SerDes, SI / PI, PCB / PCBA, and validation instruments [3][33]. | [3][33] |
| Measurable parameter | The SI flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR Impedance as measurement / analysis items [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Oscilloscope role | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices; Power Distribution Network is mapped to scopes and network analyzers [1][3]. | [1][3] |
| Required Oscilloscope capability | Not specified: the passages explicitly say the source does not provide model, bandwidth, data rate, standard version, software option, test condition, or pass/fail criteria [1][2][32]. | [1][2][32] |
【推論】A defensible chain is: high-speed SerDes / electrical-interface validation requirement → SI parameters such as Eye diagram and TDR impedance → oscilloscope involvement in Interface Test or PDN testing, but the required oscilloscope capability remains “知識庫未標示” because the cited passages do not provide scope specifications or options [1][2][3][32].
